name: sphere-gallery
title: Sphere Gallery
description: WebGL gallery of images mapped onto a sphere that you can orbit and focus.

meta.interaction: Drag to rotate the sphere. Click a tile to bring it forward with a lens-blurred background; Escape dismisses it.

props.name: mode
props.description:
- texture: children render into an FBO each frame: Global post-processing will work on it.
- scissor: a scissored pass painted on top of the composed frame. lighter, but excluded from global post-processing.
